plan.promotion: Reused diagnostic targets cannot establish readiness or independent promotion
plan.negative_control: Same shared positivity scale<=.25; learned/shuffled norms matched before projection and postprojection ratio[.9,1.1]; invalid comparison retained without reward/promotion
plan.repair_policy: Adapter unpacks load_core tuple; no changed scientific settings or scores. Prior batch failed before any scoring; frozen forecasts rederived without training. Original sources/events kept.
